Seafood and pantry from one supplier

Japanese and pan-Asian kitchens typically buy fish, roe and pantry staples from several vendors. Because we supply both sushi-grade seafood and the dry and chilled ingredients around it, your team can consolidate orders and deliveries.

Our Korean range currently covers core items such as gochujang; if your menu needs specific Korean products, tell us what you use and we will confirm what we can supply.
